mapper.sql: id, user_id, scene, context_type, context_id, type, title, reason, action_type, action_label, action_path, score, estimated_minutes, subject, knowledge_point, status, accepted_task_id, dedup_key, expires_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_recommendation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scene = #{scene} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now}) ORDER BY score DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_recommendation (user_id, scene, context_type, context_id, type, title, reason, action_type, action_label, action_path, score, estimated_minutes, subject, knowledge_point, status, accepted_task_id, dedup_key, expires_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scene}, #{contextType}, #{contextId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{reason}, #{actionType}, #{actionLabel}, #{actionPath}, #{score}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{subject}, #{knowledgePoint}, #{status}, #{acceptedTaskId}, #{dedupKey}, #{expiresAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_recommendation SET status = 'ACCEPTED', accepted_task_id = #{taskId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
